edit_items: public read.name: edit_items: public read
edit_items: public read.using: exists (select 1 from public.edits e where e.id = "edit_items"."edit_id" and e.published) and exists (select 1 from public.products p where p.id = "edit_items"."product_id" and p.published)

product_images: public read.name: product_images: public read
product_images: public read.using: exists (select 1 from public.products p where p.id = "product_images"."product_id" and p.published)

products_video_limits.name: products_video_limits
products_video_limits.value: "products"."video" is null or (("products"."video"->>'bytes')::int <= 2097152 and ("products"."video"->>'durationMs')::int between 5000 and 8000 and "products"."video" ? 'path' and "products"."video" ? 'poster')

variants: public read.name: variants: public read
variants: public read.using: exists (select 1 from public.products p where p.id = "variants"."product_id" and p.published)
